protocol.phase: development natural three-player matches; not constructed or final holdout
protocol.traceRetention: Only the first candidate death window per match; no complete per-tick recording

retention.purpose: Compact development evidence; not final evaluation. Protocols, summaries, all match outcomes/player metrics/faults/initial states/setups are retained.
retention.events: Fire events retained only for named representative cases; pickup, shield and death events retained for all matches.
retention.traces: Nonrepresentative traces removed; selected action/position/bullet windows retained. No full replay or backup copy.
